podcast.title: Commercial Success and Media Use
podcast.body: This song, released in 1992, became a top 40 hit and served as the theme song for "The Wedge," a MuchMusic show dedicated to promoting alternative rock in the 1990s. "This song became a top 40 hit, and here's that much music reference. It was used as the theme song for the show The Wedge, which was all about promoting the alt rock side of things back in the 90s."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
